verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of running a Linux terminal environment, VM, or WSL-like feature on macOS; only unrelated Continuity, Migration Assistant, and Windows-via-Boot-Camp/Parallels references (Run Windows on your Mac) appear. This is a fair question for a desktop OS (comparable to WSL on Windows), but no capability is documented, so it is 'none' rather than 'na'.
